title: CI: pull_request workflows silently not scheduled for some branch pushes (no github-actions suite)
body:
## Observed

Three branch pushes produced **zero** GitHub Actions runs — no `github-actions` check suite exists on the head commits — while third-party app suites (Graphite, GitGuardian, CodeRabbit, etc.) attached normally, proving push delivery worked:

| PR | pushed head | GHA runs scheduled |
|----|-------------|--------------------|
| #5240 | `a4dbe8d1b57c7f3c4af4381d86497519103cf819` | none (only manual `workflow_dispatch` 37179060658 afterwards) |
| #5260 | `08893708b7224a0c3c4c1e6d6c267b45675ca11f` | none (only manual `workflow_dispatch` 37179062313 afterwards) |
| #5260 | `695d770d3c547b71a8294650456daf0795fb7314` | none (manual `workflow_dispatch` 37182976007 in progress) |

Contrast cases on the same repo at the same time:
- `9b0a3a12c` (#5260, earlier head): exactly **two** `pull_request` runs scheduled — `Security` (37175899927) and `PR Plan` (37175899926) — but NOT `Routed Rust Small`, `CI`, `Coverage`, etc.
- `feat/issue-lifecycle-attempt-contract-4929` push at 2026-10-04T06:27:39Z: full fleet scheduled (`Routed Rust Small`, `CI`, `Coverage`, `Security`, `Source of Truth`, `PR Plan`, ...). Actions delivery healthy repo-wide.

## Evidence

- `gh api repos/.../commits/695d770d3.../check-suites --paginate`: 12 app suites, none with `app.slug == github-actions`.
- `gh run list --branch bench/agentic-benchmarks-b1-b6`: newest run before manual dispatch was the older dispatch; no `pull_request`-event run for `695d770d3`.
- `routed-rust.yml` `on.pull_request.types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled]` has no paths filter; push to an open PR branch should schedule `synchronize`.
- Commit messages contain no `[skip ci]`-family directive.
- Required check is `Ripr Rust Small Result` (classic protection); manual `workflow_dispatch` provably posts it, so dispatch is a working unblock.

## Impact

Every affected push needs a manual `gh workflow run routed-rust.yml --ref <branch>` plus a ~35-min wait before merge proof exists. Silent: nothing fails, nothing notifies — the runs just never appear.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Root cause identified (event delivery, scheduling skip, merge-ref staleness, or GitHub-side incident window).
- [ ] If repo-configurable (trigger types, concurrency, stale merge refs on conflicted PRs), fix landed with a same-day push proving automatic `synchronize` scheduling.
- [ ] If GitHub-side, recorded with incident window and a detection step (e.g. a push hook / xtask check that warns when a pushed PR head has no `github-actions` suite after N minutes).
